title: Bound environment probes by literal scope
failure_signature: A read-only parent-walk plus drive-capacity probe exceeded a ten-second PowerShell budget and returned no evidence.
trigger_preconditions: Parent-directory traversal and drive query in one child command
candidate_workaround: Split the probe into direct literal-path AGENTS.md checks and a separately bounded drive query with a thirty-second budget.
recurrence_guard: Use literal paths and at least thirty seconds for cold read-only environment probes; never bundle directory traversal with unrelated capacity queries.
rollback: No repository, branch, route, or host state changed; retain the timeout and resume from the last verified source gate.
protected_gates: Read applicable repository instructions before owner-file edits
scope_boundary: This method addresses local command latency only and proves no scientific, authority, production, deployment, privacy, security, accessibility, identity, personhood, or independent-reproduction claim.
